observed_source_facts: The fuzz manifest defines its own workspace and directly depends on trnm-protocol.
At exact 40a source trnm-protocol selects sha2 with feature asm on Linux x86_64/aarch64.
The original separate fuzz lock has sha2 0.10.9 without a sha2-asm dependency and without a sha2-asm package.
The faae child adds the sha2-to-sha2-asm edge and sha2-asm 0.6.4 with dependency cc to that exact separate lock; the remaining lock text is unchanged.
The quality producer's second manifest is tests/fuzz/Cargo.toml and maps to fetch-crates-1.log; the fuzz producer uses that same manifest for fetch.log.
repaired_lock_correspondence.inference: The faae lock correction addresses the missing assembly-backend dependency in the same independent graph rejected by all four original Cargo fetches. Cargo's generic lock error does not itself enumerate that dependency, so this correspondence relies on the frozen manifest and before/after lock comparison.
repaired_lock_correspondence.validation_limit: No cargo command is run by this evidence reader. Actual repaired quality/fuzz acceptance requires its own exact-source original execution; these four original jobs remain failures. Separate release results are not imported.

# The pinned backend checks the actual CPU and retains its software fallback.
# SHA-2 bytes and every validation call stay identical. sha2-asm cannot build on
# Windows; only these original native Linux targets select this implementation.
[target.'cfg(all(target_os = "linux", any(target_arch = "x86_64", target_arch = "aarch64")))'.dependencies]
sha2 = { version = "0.10", features = ["asm"] }

full = bodies[0]
    prefix = ('    cargo fmt --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml --all -- --check\n'
              '    python3 scripts/ci/run_supply_chain.py\n')
    suffix = RUST_DOCS + RUST_CLIPPY
    require(full.startswith(prefix) and full.endswith(suffix), 'Rust quality command boundary')
    runtime = full[len(prefix):-len(suffix)]
    require(code_lines(runtime) == code_lines(MODEL_OBSERVATION_BLOCK + NATIVE_RELEASE_BLOCK),
            'complete retained Rust runtime commands required')
    header = 'set -euo pipefail\nexport RUST_TEST_THREADS="${RUST_TEST_THREADS:-1}"\n'
    return {'runtime': header + runtime, 'quality': header + prefix + suffix}

for index, manifest in enumerate(MANIFESTS):
            checked(['cargo', 'fetch', '--locked', '--manifest-path', manifest],
                    output / f'fetch-crates-{index}.log', observations, expected_source=expected_source)
        checked([str(binary), '--manifest-path', MANIFESTS[0], '--config', 'deny.toml',
                 '--locked', 'fetch', 'db'], output / 'fetch-advisories.log', observations, expected_source=expected_source)

manifest = 'tests/fuzz/Cargo.toml'
    lock = ROOT / 'tests/fuzz/Cargo.lock'
    original_lock = digest(lock)
    try:
        expected_source = pin_source()
        report['source_expected'] = expected_source
        checked(['cargo', 'fuzz', '--version'], output / 'cargo-fuzz-version.log', observations, env=environment, expected_source=expected_source)
        version_text = (output / 'cargo-fuzz-version.log').read_text().strip()
        if version_text != 'cargo-fuzz ' + versions['TRNM_CARGO_FUZZ_VERSION']:
            raise ValueError('fuzz tool version mismatch')
        report['cargo_fuzz_sha256'] = digest(binary_dir / 'cargo-fuzz')
        checked(['rustc', '--version', '--verbose'], output / 'compiler.log', observations, env=environment, expected_source=expected_source)
        host = re.search(r'^host: (\S+)$', (output / 'compiler.log').read_text(), re.M)
        if host is None:
            raise ValueError('compiler host missing')
        checked(['cargo', 'fetch', '--locked', '--manifest-path', manifest],
                output / 'fetch.log', observations, env=environment, expected_source=expected_source)
